text_html:
We just updated GameNativeX64 to fix some issues (v1.2.0-x64.31)!!
We fixed a few issues with black screen and no sound on some devices using software copy, added automatic DRI3 presentation compatibility detection, and made a few input issues around mouse/touchpad/touchscreen/stylus on our devices too.

Download the update here:
https://github.com/Bliss-Bass/GameNative-x64/releases/tag/v1.2.0-x64.31
